description: Retrieve a Replo session's current status, latest response, tool activity, errors, and pending interactions (permission requests and questions). Use to check progress after starting or continuing a session. When pendingInteractions is non-empty, show it to the user and wait for their answer, then pass it to resolve_agent_interaction: a choice takes one option value as the decision; a form takes one answers array per step.
name: get_agent_session
title: Get Replo session
